Proactive measures are necessary to mitigate the potential for entrenched dependencies on AI technology.

 - Excessive reliance on AI systems can lead to skill atrophy among individuals.
 - AI Lock-In creates systemic vulnerabilities that can be exacerbated during geopolitical conflicts.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14565

Recent studies reveal that prompts written to include diversity, equity, and inclusion considerations in medical language models can inadvertently alter patient information provided by these models. This phenomenon, termed 'demographic injection,' shows a significant increase in the addition of demographic details that were not part of the original query, which can potentially mislead medical conclusions and recommendations. Researchers have noted that a single DEI prompt can escalate the injection rate dramatically across numerous models and responses.

 - A single DEI prompt can increase the rate of demographic injection in medical language models from 0.7% to 33.1%.
 - The added demographic attributes can change the recommendations provided by the models, potentially leading to incorrect clinical guidance.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15254

This raises implications for the reliability of AI-driven clinical guidance and highlights the need for critical evaluation of prompt engineering in AI models.
